name: worker
description: Machine-side runner for cloud workers. Clones the tenant repo, runs a terminal coding agent (Claude Code, Codex) against a task, streams normalized transcript events back to the dashboard, and reports the resulting diff via a retrying callback. Dual-mode: WORKER_PARAMS inline (local dev child process) or WORKER_TOKEN one-time-Vault handshake (ephemeral Fly machine). Ships with zero @repo/* runtime deps so the Fly image stays tiny; the wire schemas are duplicated from @repo/worker-core on purpose.
